text: PT Pertamina (Persero), the group PT Pertamina Lubricants belongs to, is an Indonesian state-owned enterprise; in 2026 Danantara consolidated Pertamina Patra Niaga and its sister units into a single entity.
short: PT Pertamina (Persero) is an Indonesian state-owned enterprise; Danantara consolidated its downstream units under Patra Niaga in 2026.

source.name: PT Pertamina Hulu Energi (pertamina.com group site): Shareholder Structure
source.note: Pertamina's own upstream subholding describes its controlling shareholder, PT Pertamina (Persero), as 'a state-owned enterprise (SOE)'.

additionalSources.name: Jakarta Globe (Antara): Pertamina Unit Merger Generates Up to $700 Million in Savings, Danantara Says
additionalSources.quote: Earlier this year, Danantara consolidated Pertamina Patra Niaga, Kilang Pertamina Internasional, and Pertamina International Shipping into a single entity
additionalSources.note: The same article calls Pertamina 'state energy company Pertamina' and describes the consolidation as part of a broader effort by Danantara to streamline Indonesia's state-owned-enterprise sector.
